channel.description: Phone or LiveChat (WhatsApp, SocialMedia also accepted).

customerPhone.description: Call.Ani as-is (tel:+971...), or the chat customer phone if collected.

departmentCode.description: Optional explicit TigerCS department code (IVR / chat menu choice). Wins over the queue mapping.

queueId.description: Genesys queue id the flow is transferring to - mapped to a department in TigerCS.

serviceRequestId.description: Optional but REQUIRED for a second request in the same conversation. A stable id YOU choose for ONE distinct service request (e.g. documents, leasing) - the conversationId + serviceRequestId pair is the idempotency key, so each distinct request gets its own ticket and a retry of the same pair returns the same ticket. Omit it and the whole conversation stays one ticket (the old behaviour).

humanFollowUpRequired.description: Optional. true when this request needs a person (apartment leasing, a complaint). The ticket is then never closed by the chatbot inactivity timers, closedByAi or document delivery - only by an employee in TigerCS. Leave blank for a request the bot completes itself (e.g. sending documents).

requestTypeId.description: Optional. The id of the configured request type the customer selected, from this environment's Request Type export (a data-table lookup in the flow; ids differ per environment). Preferred over requestTypeName. Blank = not supplied. If requestTypeName is also sent it must be the same request type or the call is refused (422).

requestTypeName.description: Optional. Fallback only when no id is available: the exact name of one active request type (refused if the name exists in more than one department). Blank = not supplied. Valid: the ticket is routed to that request type's department (the originating department is kept), auto-assigned and given its SLA and Category. Blank: the ticket is created Unclassified on Normal priority for a person to classify. An unknown or unusable value is refused (422), or sent to the configured classification queue.

successSchema.title: TigerCS - Create or Reuse Ticket result

outcome.description: TicketCreated or AlreadyIngested (a retry - same ticket).

ticketId.description: TigerCS ticket id - store as participant data TigerCsTicketId.

ticketNumber.description: TigerCS ticket number - store as participant data TigerCsTicketNumber.
